name: Facet
text: Choose a full-height left sidebar for primary navigation and context, collapsing to a thin tab when unused. It keeps controls and key metrics always visible without cluttering the main view, matching the "Graphify Dashboard" pattern where users need persistent access to tools. Trade-off: it steals 20% of screen width, but the liveliness and speed of screwing around with data outweighs the loss of horizontal space.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A left sidebar still risks users missing updates if they’re deep in the graph—like missing a notification while scrolling. A thin top banner with a pulsing indicator would keep visibility without stealing 20% of the screen. Settle it with a quick user test: track how often users miss updates in each layout.
